_comment: M7-20 retune UNDER THE CLAIM POLICY. Two corrections to the M7-15 pool, both from the claim-channel work: (a) the claim-reading member was modelled as an UNCONDITIONAL lag-1 truth feed, but M7-18 measured the real channel at LAG 0 (the cop claims the cell it is standing on when the thief decides) - and under M7-19's policy the reader only learns on turns we actually declared, so the faithful model is base-hidden + claim_feed truth, not feed truth-lag1; (b) the candidate now evolves WITH claim_threshold 0.1 - the policy we deployed - so fitness scores the captures it can actually convert (a landing it never declares is forfeit, book scoring table 2). Same seeds 401..416 as M7-15 so the two runs are comparable; the gate seeds (1..32) stay disjoint. Weights land in a SEPARATE artifact and deploy only via config review - never automatically, never to the sparring host. SEEDS 401..432 (32, not M7-15's 16): a first attempt at 16 seeds produced a COMPLETELY FLAT curve - default, deployed and evolved vectors all scored exactly 0.6406 - because 64 games cannot resolve vectors whose true separation is ~0.03-0.25 per member. The run was under-powered, not the landscape empty. Diagnosed by measuring per-member spread across four deliberately spread-out vectors (default / deployed / chase-max / wall-max) at 32 seeds before rerunning.
